dimensions.label: Distinct contribution beyond the main statement

promptAlignment: Answers the central task and every explicit content requirement
Gives each requested element enough depth and proportion
Uses the requested document purpose and audience
Connects the response to the stated application context without importing irrelevant requirements
throughlineStructure: Opens with a specific, earned moment, question, or idea
Sustains one organizing argument across the draft
Sequences purposeful paragraphs so experiences develop the argument
Closes with a direction earned by the preceding material
evidenceSpecificity: Makes the applicant’s own role and action clear
Provides enough setting, method, decision, or constraint to understand the experience
Shows a credible result, consequence, or learning connected to the action
Develops relevant experiences in depth and supports the major claims
proseControl: Communicates meaning clearly at sentence level
Uses precise wording with mechanics that support comprehension
Gives paragraphs clear functions and readable transitions
Uses space purposefully without repetition, padding, or unnecessary detail
voiceAuthenticity: Grounds the writing in applicant-specific experience and reasoning
Makes perspective and interpretation particular rather than interchangeable
Keeps claims proportionate and explainable from the information in the draft
Uses a natural, controlled voice without formulaic language obscuring meaning
goalsDirection: States an understandable next direction appropriate to the prompt
Connects that direction to prior experience or motivation
Explains the capability gap or next developmental step
Keeps the ambition plausible and proportionate to the evidence
preparation: Selects relevant academic or professional preparation
Shows what the applicant actually did or learned
Connects preparation to the demands of the proposed training
intellectualDirection: Defines a focused topic, problem, or question
Explains why it merits investigation or training
Sets a credible next learning or research direction
programFit: Identifies relevant program features appropriate to this degree
Explains how those features meet a specific learning or research need
Connects preparation and goals to those opportunities
Makes a coherent two-way case for participation or contribution
motivationFormative: Shows concrete circumstances and the applicant’s response
Explains how the experience shaped motivation
Connects that motivation to this application
reflectionGrowth: Interprets an experience rather than merely recounting it
Explains a change in understanding or judgment
Shows how that change affected later action or direction
Acknowledges complexity or limits without a generic moral
perspectiveContribution: Shows a particular perspective grounded in experience
Explains how it shapes engagement with others or the field
Supports a credible contribution with past action or preparation
Connects that contribution to the requested community or context
livedContext: Provides relevant context on the applicant’s path
Shows how circumstances shaped choices or opportunities
Makes agency and response visible without demanding hardship disclosure
Connects that context to the purpose of the statement
researchAgenda: Defines a researchable question or connected agenda
Explains its significance or unresolved problem
Connects it to prior work or preparation
Bounds its scope at the appropriate career stage
methodsAwareness: Selects an approach relevant to the question
Explains how the approach would address it
Shows appropriate technical preparation or a realistic learning plan
Recognizes relevant data, design, inference, or ethical limitations
feasibilityContribution: Addresses needed data, access, resources, or conditions
Recognizes major constraints and a plausible response
Explains the contribution without overstating novelty or certainty
facultyDisciplinaryFit: Identifies a relevant intellectual or disciplinary setting
Explains the connection between the proposed work and that setting
Links a real training or collaboration need to a supplied resource
Gives substantive reasons for fit rather than name lists or reputation
missionAlignment: Identifies the scholarship’s supplied aims or selection criteria
Connects those aims to the applicant’s experience
Shows alignment through choices or action
Explains what the award would enable in that context
leadershipImpact: Defines the applicant’s responsibility and scope
Shows a consequential decision or coordinated action
Explains an outcome with appropriate attribution to others
Connects the experience to a credible lesson or later leadership
futureContribution: Connects it to prior preparation or action
Explains a plausible route to delivering it
Aligns its scope with the award, field, or community
challengeDecision: Defines a concrete challenge and stakes
Shows judgment among options or constraints
Connects the decision to consequences and reflection
careerSpecificity: Identifies a plausible next role, problem, or field
Makes the intended setting or beneficiaries understandable
Explains why that direction follows from the applicant’s preparation
whyNowLogic: Identifies the transition or capability gap
Shows why the current preparation is insufficient for the next step
Explains why this degree addresses that gap
Explains why the timing is credible
preparationAlignment: Selects preparation relevant to the stated goal
Explains what transfers to the proposed path
degreeIntegration: Defines a problem that requires both disciplines
Explains the distinct contribution of each degree
Shows how those capabilities will work together
Makes the combined route more coherent than two unrelated ambitions
careerLogicWhyNow: Explains why the combined training is needed now
motivationPreparation: Explains a specific motivation for applying
Shows relevant preparation through action or learning
Connects motivation and preparation to the next step
fitContribution: Identifies relevant features of the supplied target
Explains why those features fit an actual need
Shows what the applicant brings through evidence
Connects intended contribution to that target
directPromptResponse: Takes a clear position or directly answers the central question
Uses evidence relevant to that answer
Develops the answer to the requested depth
Keeps the response focused on this task
singleCentralPoint: Maintains coherence within the available space
Ends with a conclusion that follows from that point
addsBeyondMain: Contributes information or perspective beyond the supplied main statement
Avoids unnecessary duplication of its examples and argument
Connects the additional material to this prompt
Adds useful depth to the application as a whole
documentPurpose: Makes the purpose of the document clear
Selects content suited to the stated audience
Supports the central case with relevant material
Answers the supplied task in an appropriate form
